name: Coca-Cola UNITED - New Orleans Production Plant, LA

fieldNotes.location: EXACT BUILDING NOT POSITIVELY CONFIRMED. Roster address (12970 I-10 Service Rd, New Orleans East) and roster coords (30.0524,-89.9520) are wrong - that point is a residential/stadium area with no industrial plant. Web research is consistent: the Coca-Cola UNITED New Orleans production plant ('New Orleans Production Center', operated by Crescent City Coca-Cola Bottling Company UNITED) is at 5601 Citrus Blvd, Harahan/Elmwood LA 70123 - the largest Coca-Cola plant in Louisiana, described as a 12-story tower spanning a football field, in the Elmwood industrial park.
fieldNotes.search: Probed the Elmwood industrial park extensively (z15-z20) and street-viewed Citrus Blvd (the Mississippi River levee road) and many internal streets. Could not isolate the 12-story tower - the park has hundreds of similar large warehouses and the tower (likely an internal automated high-bay) is not clearly distinguishable in near-nadir satellite imagery. The strongest positive signal found was a Coca-Cola-branded 'muster station' assembly-point sign at the corner near 29.9461,-90.1928, beside a blue-privacy-fenced industrial facility with a trailer yard.
fieldNotes.estimate: The coords and geofence here are a BEST ESTIMATE centered on the building cluster near that Coca-Cola muster-station sign. All classification fields are low-confidence inferences from generic Elmwood-industrial-park layout and are listed in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Elmwood is a dense industrial park inside the New Orleans metro - Urban is confident regardless of exact building.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur evident in the area probed.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Flag for human review - needs a person to confirm the exact 5601 Citrus Blvd building footprint before classification can be trusted.
